package_coverage.confirming_evidence: Production routing, material-issue, work-in-process, or supplier capacity records show that the reported assembly-start basis begins only after the required interposer and substrate are available.
package_coverage.falsifying_evidence: The assembly-start source is a tool-slot or theoretical-throughput measure before interposer or substrate availability, requiring those material pools to remain separate constraints.
package_coverage.methodology: Defines each synthetic package assembly start as a package slot for which the required silicon interposer and ABF substrate have already been issued. This prevents the same material availability from constraining output again downstream; it does not estimate either material pool independently.
package_coverage.notes: Synthetic scope declaration used to expose and prevent potential double counting. Direct interposer and substrate capacity remain evidence gaps.

replacement.confirming_evidence: The hash-pinned capacity-draw artifact reproduces the supplier result's aggregate and per-supplier distributions and conserves every stack-to-package conversion.
replacement.double_count_guard: The aggregate HBM wafer flow is not sampled or emitted; only the supplier result's customer-allocated stack pool enters package attempts.
replacement.falsifying_evidence: A source correction changes supplier scope, topology, qualification, allocation, the customer-allocated stack distribution, or any pinned capacity-draw byte.
replacement.notes: A deterministic permutation preserves the full HBM marginal and within-draw supplier allocation without asserting an unsupported draw-index relationship to logic or packaging.

hbm_supplier_result.scope: The frozen supplier portfolio's Blackwell-qualified and customer-allocated HBM3E stacks across three non-overlapping declared capacity scopes, including every underlying capacity draw.

manufacturing_scenario.scope: The frozen Blackwell logic and advanced-package scenario, with its aggregate HBM wafer flow removed before reconciliation.
